gaps.quote: Each role stream then holds $V/(2W)$ bits (cited).
gaps.note: Wrong constant. The paper (lines 125-129) says all role streams contain V/W bits, and the proof of the row-splitting lemma (about line 525) says each stream has volume V/W. The V bits are split equally among W roles, so each holds V/W, not V/(2W). The page also does not derive the count.

gaps.quote: Frames therefore pass through every gate, linear or not.
gaps.note: Overstated and false. The identity G(D f_1,...,D f_p)=D G(f_1,...,f_p) was shown only for pointwise linear gates, and it uses linearity of G. The paper (lines 137-139 and 810-813) states that the common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate only. A nonlinear gate need not commute with a frame, which mixes addresses.
